items.name: REPLYGO
items.description: ReplyGo turns a single bio link into a mini storefront for creators, affiliates, and small sellers: business profile, product catalog, Xendit QRIS checkout, shipping checks, dynamic QR codes, and branded invoices, plus an AI assistant that helps followers find products and get answers before checkout.

caseStudy.problem: Creators, affiliates, and small sellers sell from one bio link. ReplyGo puts the catalog, checkout, shipping checks, and buyer questions behind that link.
caseStudy.role: Built at PT Rigo Inovasi Digital as part of my Lead Fullstack Engineer role, across the Rust backend and React frontend.

flow.label: BIO_PAGE
flow.detail: Business profile, product catalog, and AI assistant.

flow.label: AI_ASSISTANT
flow.detail: Answers buyers from the seller's knowledge base.

flow.detail: Xendit QRIS payment with shipping checks.

flow.label: WEBHOOK_JOB
flow.detail: Payment events run as durable background jobs.

flow.label: INVOICE
flow.detail: Branded PDF invoice generated for the order.

decisions.title: Tenant isolation in the schema
decisions.detail: Tenant tables use composite foreign keys on organization_id, so PostgreSQL rejects links across organizations.

decisions.title: Durable jobs inside PostgreSQL
decisions.detail: A shared workflow engine stores jobs in PostgreSQL with retries and idempotency keys. Delivery is at-least-once, so handlers are idempotent.

decisions.title: pgvector with tenant filters
decisions.detail: Knowledge search uses HNSW with iterative scan, so tenant filters cannot truncate the candidate list.

decisions.title: Redis pub/sub for realtime
decisions.detail: Pub/sub is the one path to sockets. A socket that falls behind is told to resync, and a busy organization does not wake every socket.

decisions.title: Modular monolith in Rust
decisions.detail: Axum and SeaORM in one deployable, with a module per domain such as orders, billing, and knowledge.

items.name: CHATRIGO
items.description: Multi-tenant B2B omnichannel chatbot SaaS unifying WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, LINE, and web chat into per-tenant workspaces, with Xendit QRIS billing, conversation summaries, and tenant RBAC. Designed the RAG orchestration layer and an AI sales agent with evidence-bound product recommendations, scoping every query by tenant. Led architecture and code review for a team of 8 interns.

caseStudy.problem: Businesses talk to customers on WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, LINE, and web chat, each in its own inbox. Chatrigo brings them into one workspace per tenant, with an AI agent that sells from the business's own data.
caseStudy.role: Lead Fullstack Engineer at PT Rigo Inovasi Digital. I own architecture, code review, and SDLC standards for a team of 8 interns, 4 of them directly managed.

flow.label: CHANNELS
flow.detail: Customer messages arrive from five channels.

flow.label: NESTJS_API
flow.detail: Verifies webhooks and routes each message to the right tenant.

flow.label: AI_AGENT
flow.detail: Calls scoped tools for facts, or hands over to a human.

flow.label: WORKSPACE
flow.detail: Staff see replies live through Socket.IO and Redis.

decisions.title: Tools instead of free-form answers
decisions.detail: The agent works through four narrow tools: knowledge search, product search, business info, and human handover. Answers stay tied to retrieved data.

decisions.title: Guardrails around the model
decisions.detail: Off-topic requests get declined, customers can ask for a human, and handover notes are stripped of secrets and prompt text.

decisions.title: Every query scoped by tenant
decisions.detail: Knowledge chunks load per business profile, so one organization's data does not surface in another's workspace.

decisions.title: Temporal for billing
decisions.detail: QRIS creation, expiry, and payment switching run as durable workflows, so timers and retries survive restarts.

decisions.title: Redis behind Socket.IO
decisions.detail: A Redis adapter fans events out across instances, so staff get updates on any server.

items.name: CHATRIGO MOBILE
items.description: Companion mobile app for the Chatrigo omnichannel platform — lets teams stay on top of customer conversations and agent workflows on the go, connected to the same SaaS backend as the web product.

items.name: E-SIGN
items.description: Digital signature and document verification platform for the city government: QR-code stamping, queued background PDF processing, and verification against official government APIs. Deployed for school document signing across Balikpapan's 278 primary and junior-secondary schools (198 SD, 80 SMP).

caseStudy.problem: City documents, including school documents, needed digital signatures that can be verified, and signing them one at a time does not scale.
caseStudy.role: Fullstack Developer Intern at Diskominfo Balikpapan. I built this Laravel platform during a five-month internship.

flow.label: REQUEST
flow.detail: Staff submit a single PDF or a ZIP batch.

flow.label: QUEUE
flow.detail: Background workers process the PDFs.

flow.label: SIGN
flow.detail: Each document gets a certified signature and QR stamp.

flow.label: VERIFY
flow.detail: Validity is checked against official government APIs.

flow.label: RESULT
flow.detail: Signer, certificate, and timestamp shown as valid.

decisions.title: PDF work in background queues
decisions.detail: Queue workers handle PDF processing, so a batch does not hold up the web request.

decisions.title: Batch requests
decisions.detail: One request can carry many files, and status is tracked per file.

decisions.title: Official verification
decisions.detail: Results come from official government APIs and show certificate status plus a BSSN timestamp authority.

decisions.title: QR placement by text tag
decisions.detail: A tag inside the document sets the QR coordinates, so nobody positions it by hand on every file.

items.name: E-KGB
items.description: Personnel management web app for municipal staff, covering periodic salary review and promotion (KGB) requests with role-based dashboards, process automation, and authenticated access control.

caseStudy.problem: Municipal staff are due a periodic salary review (KGB) every two years. HR needs to see who is due across city departments and act in time.
caseStudy.role: Fullstack Developer Intern at Diskominfo Balikpapan. I built this Laravel and Tailwind CSS application during the same internship.

flow.label: MASTER_DATA
flow.detail: Employees, ranks, positions, grades, and departments.

flow.label: NEXT_DATE
flow.detail: The next KGB date is tracked per employee.

flow.label: STATUS
flow.detail: Marks each case as due or not yet due, with days left.

flow.label: ACTION
flow.detail: Staff process KGB and promotion requests.

decisions.title: Status from dates
decisions.detail: The list shows each next review date, its status, and the days left, so due cases stand out.

decisions.title: Filters by department
decisions.detail: SKPD and status filters let staff narrow a citywide list down to the cases they own.

decisions.title: One set of master data
decisions.detail: Employees, positions, grades, and departments sit in shared master data behind both workflows.

decisions.title: Role-based access
decisions.detail: Authenticated access and role-based dashboards protect municipal staff data.

items.details: Lead architecture, code review, and SDLC standards for a team of 8 interns, 4 of them directly managed. Architected Chatrigo, a multi-tenant omnichannel chatbot platform unifying WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, LINE, and web chat, used by 10 business users across client organizations. Built ReplyGo, a link-in-bio storefront with a Rust/Axum backend and an AI assistant. Designed the RAG orchestration layer that grounds responses in each tenant's knowledge base and scopes every query by tenant.

Shipped three municipal systems into production during a five-month internship; all remain live today. Built an e-signature platform (Laravel) deployed for school document signing across Balikpapan's 278 primary and junior-secondary schools, a personnel management application for salary review and promotion (KGB) requests, and a Flutter web and mobile public-service application (E-Manuntung).
Built and maintained the UNITY UMN English competition site in parallel with the Diskominfo internship; owned event registration and content-publishing flows.

Taught Machine Learning, Algorithms & Data Structures, Web Programming, Mobile Application Programming, and Introduction to Internet Technology. Mentored and evaluated 200+ students across laboratory sessions and authored exam materials used for official university assessment.
